notes: The appositional even stands before a phrase no object marker or other morpheme marks, so it is added under rules 16 and 30.
The supplied unto is placed on Hor, the noun opening the Hebrew phrase, with the competing reading (unto on ha-har, the word it precedes in English) named in that unit's note under rule 8.
The article of ha-har is unrepresented because the ASV writes mount anarthrously (rule 29).
